newsitem.title: USA: TII sees Q3 sales of $12.5 million. [CORRECTED 15:22 GMT]
newsitem.headline: TII sees Q3 sales of $12.5 million. [CORRECTED 15:22 GMT]

text.p: TII Industries Inc's Chief Financial Officer, Paul Sebetic, said the company sees third quarter ending March (corrects from June) 1997 sales of $12.5 million and earnings of $500,000, or $0.07 per share fully diluted, prior to a one-time restructuring charge of $3.0 million, or $0.36 per share.
Sebetic also said that "management believes that revenues will ... exceed $50 million this fiscal year."
TII Industries designs, manufactures and sells overvoltage surge protection, fiber optic, network interface and electronic products.
The company said the restructuring, which will begin in the third quarter, should be completed during the fourth quarter ending June 1997.

The charge will cover a reduction of its workforce, consolidation and relocation of operations, and will also eliminate certain products and related inventories with limited growth potential, TII said.

TII also said that at the end of the third quarter, Access Network Technologies, a joint venture between Lucent Technologies Inc and Raychem Corp, informed the company that it would discontinue its operations.
As a result both TII and Raychem intend to directly manufacture and market the products that were previously sold by the Access Network, it said.
